properties.name: krizaka.web.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Exact browser origins (scheme, host, port) allowed to call the service. Empty, the default, allows none and registers no CORS policy; '*' is refused.

properties.name: krizaka.web.problems.base-type
properties.description: Prefix every Problem Details 'type' is resolved against: the type is this base followed by the problem's code. Absolute, ending with '/'.

properties.name: krizaka.security.jwt.secret
properties.description: Shared HMAC-SHA256 secret session tokens are verified with, at least 32 characters (256 bits). Setting it switches local token verification on.

properties.name: krizaka.observability.product
properties.description: Product the service belongs to, e.g. 'orazaka'. Required: tagged on every meter.

properties.name: krizaka.observability.service
properties.description: Short name of the service within its product, e.g. 'conversation'. Required: tagged on every meter.

properties.name: krizaka.observability.version
properties.description: Version of the running build, usually filtered in by the build ('@project.version@'). Required: tagged on every meter.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.consumer.enabled
properties.description: Whether krizaka-messaging contributes the JSON message converter and the listener container factory (retry with back-off, then <queue>.dlq).

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.dedup.store
properties.description: Where claims are kept: 'jdbc' (durable, shared by the instances) or 'memory' (one instance). Required to get a MessageDedup bean; never inferred from the classpath.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.dedup.table
properties.description: Table the claims are kept in when the store is 'jdbc'.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.exchanges.dead-letter
properties.description: Direct exchange failed messages are dead-lettered to; must differ from the events exchange.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.exchanges.events
properties.description: Topic exchange domain events are published to.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Most rows one batch claims and publishes.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.outbox.enabled
properties.description: Whether a relay is scheduled for each OutboxStore bean.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.outbox.failure-threshold
properties.description: Consecutive failures (batches that threw, publishes that failed) after which the outbox health indicator reports DOWN; reset by the next success.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.outbox.lease
properties.description: How long a row claimed by a leasing store stays invisible to the other relays. Keep it longer than a batch takes to publish, or two relays publish the same row.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.outbox.poll-interval
properties.description: Delay between two batches of pending rows.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.outbox.purge-interval
properties.description: Delay between two purges of published rows.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.outbox.retention
properties.description: How long published rows are kept before the purge deletes them.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.producer
properties.description: Name of this service, stamped on every event it publishes (kz-producer). Required as soon as an EventPublisher is injected; never guessed from the application name.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.retry.initial
properties.description: Wait before the second attempt.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.retry.max
properties.description: Longest wait between two attempts, not shorter than the initial wait.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: How many times the listener runs before the message is dead-lettered, the first delivery included; at least 1.

properties.name: krizaka.messaging.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Factor between two consecutive waits; at least 1.

values.description: Claims in the application's database: durable, shared by every instance.
Claims in this instance's memory: tests, or a single instance that accepts losing them on restart.

properties.name: krizaka.app-config.admin.authority
properties.description: Authority a caller must hold to use the admin API.

properties.name: krizaka.app-config.admin.enabled
properties.description: Whether the audited admin API (/api/v1/admin/app-config) is registered.

properties.name: krizaka.app-config.cache-ttl
properties.description: How long this instance reuses a parameter set it read.

properties.name: krizaka.app-config.enabled
properties.description: Whether the app-config endpoint and the version filter are registered.

properties.name: krizaka.app-config.guard.enabled
properties.description: Whether the 426 Upgrade Required filter is registered.

properties.name: krizaka.app-config.guard.exclude
properties.description: Ant patterns the filter never guards: the app-config endpoint itself, so an old client can always learn it must update.

properties.name: krizaka.app-config.guard.include
properties.description: Ant patterns of the paths the filter guards.

properties.name: krizaka.app-config.http-max-age
properties.description: Max-age of the public app-config endpoint, for CDNs and clients.

properties.name: krizaka.app-config.store
properties.description: Where the parameters are kept: 'jdbc' (the application's database) or 'memory' (tests and demos).

values.description: Parameters in the application's database, through its JdbcTemplate.
Parameters in memory: tests and demos.

properties.name: krizaka.idempotency.purge-interval
properties.description: Delay between two purges of the keys older than the time-to-live.

properties.name: krizaka.idempotency.store
properties.description: Where keys and their responses are kept: 'jdbc' (PostgreSQL, in the action's transaction, shared by every instance) or 'memory' (one instance). Required to get the Idempotency bean; never inferred from the classpath.

properties.name: krizaka.idempotency.table
properties.description: Table the keys are kept in when the store is 'jdbc'.

properties.name: krizaka.idempotency.ttl
properties.description: How long a key replays its response; after it, the same key runs the action again.

values.description: Keys in the application's PostgreSQL database, in the action's transaction, shared by every instance.
Keys in this instance's memory: tests, demos, a single instance.
